arguments.content: Recovery operation identity must remain distinct from resource identity. A resource-keyed scan of retained audit records can select an earlier completed operation for a fresh request: skipping the effect while returning the new operation ID creates a false success and loses the new audit record. Preserve operation-keyed recovery lookup, and verify a fresh ID on a resource with a retained completed record. Observed as P1 in service.py staged review against feeb199add2b6ae7b800a45b7b6856ab45ad2a67; independent source review and parent execution reproduced it.
